beats.summary: Dwight confronts Michael demanding that either Jim or he must leave the office due to ongoing issues.

evidence.snippet:
Jim: This came out really well. There you go.
[STAGE] picks up Dwight's I.D. from the laminating machine and hands it to Dwight
Dwight: This is humongous. I am not a security threat…
Jim: Oh.
Dwight: And my middle name is 'Kurt', not 'Fart'

beats.summary: Michael reads Dwight's complaints about Jim's pranks and mischief.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Okay, so Dwight, in your own words – "Someone replaced all my pens and pencils with crayons. I suspect Jim Halpert."

beats.summary: Jim admits to orchestrating pranks on Dwight and acknowledges their impact.

evidence.snippet: Jim (laughs): Yes! Five bucks each. And it was totally worth it.
Jim: Just a simple macro. You know, these actually don't sound that funny one after another.

beats.summary: Michael calls Jim and Dwight into a conference room to resolve their conflict with a 'cage match'.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Okay… you two, in the conference room with me. Nobody leaves until we work this out. Cage match!
Michael: Cage matches? Yeah, they work. How could they not work?

beats.summary: Michael attempts to take a group photo of the office staff but struggles to get everyone to smile.

evidence.snippet: Photographer: One, two, three… smile. Try to smile.
